messages:
gina-support: Hey team, Evergreen Analytics just flagged that invoice INV-2026-0043 was sent without their Purchase Order number. AP is refusing to process payment until we reissue with PO 'PO-9981'. :warning:
liam-support: Ack. Do we have the original invoice PDF + internal billing record?
alex-customer: Confirming — AP rejected it. They need an updated invoice (same amounts) with PO-9981 in the header and invoice number referenced so their ERP links it.
jess-finance: Quick checklist — if we reissue, we need to void the old invoice and issue a credit memo, then create a replacement invoice. Tax/VAT should remain the same. Make sure to tag the new invoice "reissued_for_po" for auditing.
sam-ops: Where do we run the reissue? Console or API? I can do it if someone confirms steps.
gina-support: Steps I usually follow (console): 1) Open Billing -> Invoices -> INV-2026-0043. 2) Click 'Create Credit / Void', choose 'Incorrect/missing PO' as reason. 3) After credit is posted, click 'Create Replacement Invoice' and paste PO-9981 into the PO field before finalizing. 4) Send PDF to customer and mark as 'sent' in system.
liam-support: For API: use the credit endpoint then create invoice payload. Example (sanitized):
```
POST /api/v1/invoices/INV-2026-0043/credit
{ "reason": "missing_po", "note": "reissue with PO PO-9981" }
\nPOST /api/v1/invoices
{ "customer_id": "CUST-5544", "items": [...], "po_number": "PO-9981", "reference": "reissue of INV-2026-0043" }
```
liam-support: After that, update accounting tag: `reissue_replace:INV-2026-0043`.
jess-finance: Also confirm payment status on original — if they already attempted payment and it declined, crediting then rebilling is fine. If the original was charged successfully, we need to process a refund and coordinate timing with AP.
alex-customer: They tried to pay but AP returned it unpaid. No successful capture.
sam-ops: I'll run the console flow now. tagging @jess-finance to sign off once credit memo is created. :white_check_mark:
gina-support: Please use the customer-facing wording for the new PDF: "This invoice replaces INV-2026-0043 and includes Purchase Order PO-9981."
billing-bot: Action created: BILL-8723 - credit created for INV-2026-0043 by sam-ops.
jess-finance: Saw BILL-8723. I reviewed the credit draft, amounts match. Proceed with replacement invoice creation.
sam-ops: Replacement invoice created: INV-2026-0043-R1, PO set to PO-9981, PDF attached and emailed to billing@evergreen-analytics.com. I also added tag `reissued_for_po`.
alex-customer: Received. AP confirms they can process now. Thanks. :tada:
gina-support: Closing loop — I've updated the case with steps, attached the old & new invoice PDFs, and noted the credit memo ID CM-9902. Marking thread resolved unless anyone wants to reopen.
liam-support: Quick note for next time: there's a validation we can enable to require PO field on new invoices for customers with `requires_po=true`. Filing a separate infra ticket for that.
jess-finance: Good idea. Also can we add a small line in the invoice email: "Include PO on remittance: PO-xxxx" so APs see it immediately.
liam-support: Filed INFRA-3245 to add invoice header validation for account-level PO requirement.
gina-support: Thanks everyone. Closing. :raised_hands:
